newsitem.title: USA: DePuy acquires 89.6 pct of Landanger-Camus.
newsitem.headline: DePuy acquires 89.6 pct of Landanger-Camus.

text.p: DePuy Inc said Wednesday its DePuy Orthopedie S.A. unit has directly and indirectly acquired a total of 1.9 million shares, or 89.6 percent, of Landanger-Camus for 359.11 French francs a share, or $63.85 a share at the April 1 exchange rate.
The acquisition was in accordance with an agreement signed in February, orthopedic products maker DePuy said.
This price may be increased or decreased in the coming weeks, notably depending on the results of an audit of the France-based Landanger-Camus group, DePuy said.

Trading in Landanger-Camus shares will be suspended pending the launch of a simplified tender offer for the remaining shares to be carried out by a price guarantee procedure which, depending on the results, will be followed by a mandatory buy-out procedure, DePuy said.
